conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Division, this is Agent Brown. How may I assist you today?
Hi, um, I got a voicemail earlier saying there was a problem with my taxes? I'm not really sure what's happening.
I'm glad you called. We flagged your file during an audit of recent IRS tax returns. Can you confirm your full name and the last four digits of your Social Security number so I can access your case?
Sure, it's Jordan Hayes, and the last four numbers are 8192.

Thank you, Jordan. Please hold while I review your records... Okay, I see multiple discrepancies in your filings for the last two years, including substantial under-reported income. This is a serious IRS matter.
Oh my god, I just graduated and this is my first job. I thought I did everything right. Am I in trouble?

Unfortunately, the IRS takes tax compliance very seriously. According to our system, you owe $3,786.94 in back taxes, penalties, and interest. If not resolved immediately, you could face liens on your bank accounts, wage garnishment, and even criminal charges.
Wait, what? I can't afford that. I already have student debt. Is there anything I can do?

Listen, I understand this is overwhelming, but if you delay, the case will be escalated. That means your credit could be ruined, your employer notified, and legal action will begin. Are you prepared to handle that?
No, please. I can't lose my job or get arrested. Is there another way?

I'm willing to help you avoid further penalties, but you must cooperate now. The IRS has a fast-track resolution system, but payment is required today. I need to know how much you can pay immediately to stop asset seizure.
I don't have much. Maybe a few hundred dollars in my checking account. What should I do?

For your protection, you must not discuss this with anyone, or it will be considered interference with a federal investigation. To begin, you need to purchase government-certified payment codes from a nearby store. This is a temporary settlement.
Payment codes? I don't understand. Like, what do I buy?

You need to get prepaid gift cards, Target, Best Buy, or Apple, and load them with as much as you can. Once you have them, you will read the numbers to me. This will register your intent to settle and pause legal escalation.
Is this really how the IRS works? It sounds weird.

Jordan, these are IRS-approved methods for urgent cases. If you fail to do this now, your account will be marked for immediate enforcement, including a warrant for your arrest. Do you want the authorities coming to your home?
No, I don't. I'm really scared. I'll go to the store, but I don't know how many cards to get.
Purchase as many cards as your limit allows, in $500 increments. Do not tell anyone what they are for. Call me back as soon as you have them, and do not hang up until this is resolved.
Okay, I'm leaving now. Should I call you from the store?
Yes, stay on the line. I need to monitor the process to ensure compliance. If you disconnect or talk to store staff, the system will flag your case for non-cooperation.
Alright, I'm going right now. Please don't let them arrest me.
